description: Longstanding local businesses are the foundation, and the heart and soul of so many of our local communities across the Finger Lakes region.Seneca Falls, N.Y., September 23—State Senator Tom O’Mara (R-C, Big Flats) visited four Seneca County businesses on Wednesday to help celebrate their inclusion on the New York State Historic Business Preservation Registry.O’Mara, who nominated each of the businesses for a place on the registry, said, “Longstanding local businesses are the foundation, and the
title: O’Mara visits Seneca County businesses now designated on the NYS Historic Business Preservation Registry: Recognizing businesses that have supported local communities for over 50 years
